brief:
A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit filed by the Trump administration alleging that Harvard University failed to protect Jewish students during Gaza war protests on campus, Al Jazeera English reported. The ruling represents another legal defeat for efforts to hold universities accountable for their response to demonstrations that swept American college campuses.

The dismissal marks the latest setback in the administration's broader campaign against universities regarding campus protest activity linked to the Gaza conflict. The lawsuit had sought to compel Harvard to take stronger measures protecting Jewish students amid the unrest.
dek: Ruling latest setback in Trump administration response to Gaza war protests that swept college campuses.
title: Judge dismisses Trump lawsuit against Harvard over Jewish student safety
